summary: Iteration 30: Audit verification of multipart security test (iteration 29 correction). Ran ONLY test_upload_budget_multipart_security() from test_iteration_29_final_audit.py. Test successfully demonstrated that 2MiB non-file multipart field bypasses JsonBodyLimits middleware in isolated local ASGI test.

backend_issues.notes: No backend issues. This was an isolated audit test using local ASGI TestClient only. No production HTTP requests made.

frontend_issues.notes: No frontend testing performed. This was a backend security audit only.

passed_tests: Verified: JsonBodyLimits middleware imported from tejas.http_limits
Verified: Middleware added to test app via app.add_middleware(JsonBodyLimits)
Verified: Actual Content-Type header is multipart/form-data (not URL-encoded)
Verified: Received length is exactly 2,097,152 bytes (2 MiB)
Verified: Non-file multipart field bypasses JsonBodyLimits guard
Verified: Test executed in isolated local ASGI TestClient only (no production HTTP)

audit_scope_limitations.ui_confirmation_not_claimed: Report 29 null test was language expression simulation only, NOT actual Player UI verification. No UI confirmation performed in this iteration.
audit_scope_limitations.file_spooling_cve_not_claimed: Only non-file multipart field tested. File-spooling CVE (GHSA-2c2j-9gv5-cj73) NOT independently verified.
audit_scope_limitations.isolation_scope: Local ASGI TestClient only. No production HTTP requests. No database writes. No secrets exposed.
audit_scope_limitations.test_methodology: Corrected test now imports JsonBodyLimits, adds middleware, uses files= parameter to force multipart encoding, and asserts actual Content-Type header.

vulnerability_details.finding: JsonBodyLimits middleware only checks Content-Type: application/json. Non-file multipart/form-data fields are unbounded and bypass the guard.
